description: Build requires --destination and exactly one of --mac-address or --spec. The caller selects real NIC/network/disk values; ci-skills passes native YAML unchanged to OpenShift and returns native errors. Tools are prepared inside the Pod through CI12.0. The destination wrapper selects storage and an exact final path; it does not define an OCP schema. Native input and destination examples: references/ocp-node-image.md.

exit_codes.0: PASS, DRY_RUN, or a live read-only PLANNED result
exit_codes.2: BLOCKED or PARTIAL, or an input that could not be used

options.--apply: perform the exact confirmed build or removal
options.--binding: project-declared target and ordered kubeconfig source resolver
options.--confirm-plan: plan digest binding target, native inputs, storage, tools and functional code
options.--describe: this command's machine-readable contract, then exit
options.--dry-run: list planned probes without contacting any API; never access evidence
options.--human: human summary even when stdout is not a terminal
options.--live-plan: resolve live prerequisites and produce the confirmation digest
options.--log-file: also append sanitized diagnostics to this exact path
options.--log-format: diagnostic log format: text or JSON Lines (default: text)
options.--log-level: minimum diagnostic level: debug, info, warning, or error
options.--mac-address: joining host's actual NIC MAC; alternative to --spec
options.--network-config-path: native network YAML used with the MAC route, passed unchanged
options.--output-dir: write paired JSON and text reports to this explicit path
options.--receipt-out: write the sanitized result to this exact path
options.--revision: exact source commit of the installed copy, recorded as a claim
options.--run-id: returned run identifier for verification/removal, also used in logs
options.--spec: native nodes-config.yaml passed unchanged; alternative to --mac-address

purpose: Build an OpenShift node ISO in-cluster and verify its delivery to selected storage.
returns: Shared workflow report with native completion, callback observations, final cluster artifact identity/lifetime, plan, provenance and cleanup evidence.
side_effects: Build/remove use plan confirmation. Native oc creates its temporary workload and RBAC; the wrapper grants no additional cluster rights. ISO bytes stay in the cluster.

status_values.BLOCKED: an authority or a required read failed; see blocking_live_checks
status_values.DRY_RUN: a probe plan only, never access evidence
status_values.PARTIAL: the read completed and a component is unhealthy; see access_proven
status_values.PASS: every selected authority and live check passed
status_values.PLANNED: a live read-only operation plan, with no resource mutation
status_values.UNKNOWN: a per-item reading could not be taken, preserved rather than coerced

build.purpose: Build from either a MAC or native YAML and verify the exact cluster destination.
build.read_back: Native completion, embedded Ignition, actual ISO size/SHA-256 and destination.
build.side_effects: Confirmed build stages a tool Pod and native OpenShift temporary resources, writes the requested ISO, and retains its run record; temporary final storage retains its Pod.

remove.purpose: Remove owned run resources while preserving persistent destination storage and ISO.
remove.read_back: Owned resource absence and, for persistent output, unchanged ISO before and after removal.
remove.side_effects: Confirmed removal deletes only run-owned resources; temporary output ends with its Pod. Persistent ISO and caller storage remain.

verify.purpose: Read and inspect the existing cluster-held ISO identified by its run.
verify.read_back: Exact stored artifact identity, size/SHA-256 and embedded Ignition.
verify.side_effects: Persistent storage can require a temporary reader Pod, cleaned after inspection.
